opening.argument: The video promotes a Binance trading bot with a promised return of $457 per week and directs viewers to download the software. Its own installation guidance tells viewers to disconnect antivirus protection if it warns about the file and to “Disable/Remove Antivirus,” while describing the file as a crack. The displayed interface reinforces that the promoted utility is an automated trading tool, showing “BINANCE TRADE BOT” with “START” and “OPTIONS” controls and a “BINANCE BOT” dashboard with an “Auto bot” control. Those combined promises and installation instructions establish the deceptive trading-bot promotion at issue. The record does not establish Binance affiliation, the file’s contents, or any completed transaction or loss.
